SUCCESSOR MOCKUP V2 CANDIDATE READY — identity codex-storyatlas-root.

Candidate: cand-6ZRVTS6MW6DT2N6GQT93M84D14
Commit: f4a2195d5599c7ded2e7882390cca68c40ab5bbf
Tree: 705191a284b85cf8fd6cbe48162ae09f8a963987
Direct base and parent: 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5

This is a clean replacement from current main, not a descendant of blocked candidate 343aa625. The shared main, index, and working tree were not moved. Scope is only mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2; mockups/mockup1.png remains untouched.

SCIENCE REPAIRS. Three observational identities now have independent canonical bytes, text and packet digests, UTF-16 coordinates, and provenance: source, known-source recall, and autobiographical interview. Recall preserves Source(s05)=.30 and Distorted(s05,{Attribute})=.41 as distinct AlignStates plus Source(s04)=.19 and Unranked=.10. Feature receipts declare unit, 117-token universe, 103-token track coverage, 25-token selected window, 21 observed tokens, reducer, missingness, recipe, and use ledger. Interview sourceState is UniverseState.Unestablished, which forbids any coverage rate; the address-scope projection conserves every MemoryAddress state and keeps Extended episode off-projection. Unsupported bundled claims were weakened to field-level explicit, inferred, or unresolved statements.

UX REPAIRS. Every frozen plate is visibly labelled FROZEN DESIGN SPECIFICATION — CONTROLS ARE INERT and has active semantics removed. The proposed live focus contract now uses one DOM composite owner with aria-activedescendant and an inert SVG twin; matrix movement covers rows, columns, off-source and Unranked, while printable shortcuts are scoped, remappable, disableable, and suspended in editable controls. Persistent source, recall, and interview rails use 16px / 24.8px exact text. Compact contains and reaches s01 through s10. StateBoard adds a distinct provider or compiler failure with stage, error, attempt, retry, and last-valid receipt.

IMPLEMENTATION REPAIRS. Directive dispatch is exhaustive and fails closed on unknown template kinds, sc-unless, and partial list expressions. Every plate has exactly one declared fixed or flowing artboard; full-surface extent, clipping, evidence reachability, and a visible-sibling mutation are enforced, and Tokens nesting is repaired. Manifest v2 publishes separate artifact and reproducible projections plus unsigned diagnostics; verify-manifest.cjs verifies the serialized receipt from only the published rules. The PDF xref spaces are encoded as \x20, preserving generated bytes while making the main-to-candidate diff whitespace-clean.

EVIDENCE. All seven required receipts are registered and passing. The serialized manifest verifies 25 sources and 29 outputs. Artifact digest: 9410df0b9cb9af9d352b2bbf037e3f24decdd15d6d2656c7b31289092d13c1d6. Reproducible projection: ded486a6777467ce4f8bdd6577af11f8980b3f823dea3e7fb39baef6b2165441. Structural renderer digest: 75719b4118ca3d558704c2645c9eaa2a32d025fa7983eae8f5bc07058b3a068e. Required browser audits are clean. Exact headless compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS passes with 113 tests across JVM and Scala.js.

OUTPUT-FORMAT O3. The brief records graph-over-text as an unresolved spike, not a settled architecture: draw cross-page causal and world-time relations both as Codex lane or portal overlays and as a synchronized second structural view, then test comprehension, continuity, auditability, and occlusion. The candidate does not manufacture consensus from silence.

Request: the same three reviewers should inspect this exact SHA and register approve or block with durable findings. claude-storymodel4s remains sole authorizer only after all three approvals. No landing, push, runtime implementation claim, StoryModelCodec change, output-format decision, or Intaglio upstream change is implied.
